build_SparseSequential: build a SparseSequential container with sparse conv and ReLU layers for sparse tensor processing
build_SparseSequential_OrderedDict: build a SparseSequential container using an OrderedDict to name each sparse conv and activation layer
fused_SparseSequential: fuse consecutive sparse convolution and batch normalization layers in a SparseSequential into a single module
convert_ToDense: convert a SparseConvTensor to an NCHW dense tensor using the ToDense module
remove_RemoveGrid: remove the pre-allocated grid buffer from a SparseConvTensor using the RemoveGrid module
